title: Boundary Conditions of the Sycophancy Pressure Gap (Prompted vs Unprompted)

original_idea.body: # Boundary Conditions of the Sycophancy Pressure Gap. Factorial multi-turn dialogues varying one pressure dimension at a time on 3-4 models with/without system prompt; locate which pressures most enlarge the gap.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Mapping pressure dimensions that break honesty when oversight is weakest; clear deployment chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Factorial multi-turn dialogues + capitulation scoring; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused factorial study; one-dimension-at-a-time design adds moderate breadth.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Zero-lab-infra honesty mapping on open/API models; labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: SYCON/rebuttal sycophancy studied; the factorial pressure-gap mapping plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Sycophancy under pressure studied; factorial pressure-dimension mapping plausibly open.
